answer: A census survey blocks fakes: each agent registers one at a kernel plot and posts a 70-credit bond. A prism check scores it on origin, effort and freshness, so a copied survey fails a band. Each epoch a falcon auditor resamples plots and recounts the kernel tally; shared plots or rented surveys forfeit it. Filing starts at 40, rising 6 per identity: 1,000 fakes owe 3,037,000 and lock 70,000 more for a 40,000 pool; honest agents pay 40 once.
